column1: # data/launch.json drift, one row per gate run. Columns:
# EVERY RUN GETS A ROW, INCLUDING THE CLEAN ONES. A history that records only the
# drifted runs cannot answer "how often", and "how often" is the question that
# turned this from noise into two states. I got it wrong the other way on
# 2026-09-09 by reading a streak of four clean runs as a refutation rather than
# THE ROWS BELOW MARKED `backfilled` WERE RECONSTRUCTED BY HAND on 2026-09-09
# 23:45 from the board log and the per-run directories under gate-runs/, AFTER
# the fact and after each drifted file had already been reverted. They are
# weaker evidence than the rows the harness writes, and the `.next` column is
# UNKNOWN for all of them because nothing sampled it at the time — which is the
# whole reason the harness now samples it before gate 2 can change it. Do not
# treat an unknown as a cold build.
